example.title: Ocean Park Motel: pale blue streamline motel with a porthole window

brief: A streamline-moderne motor court in pale blue stucco: rounded corners and horizontal red speed-line trim, a porthole window, bay windows with small panes, a projecting black-and-gold neon sign ('Kitchens · Hot tub · No vacancy'), clipped hedges. One photo (2005). Older than 1970: streamline motor courts are pre-war; no newer example exists. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
